review:
A 5x5 gem hunt with pay-anywhere wins and an extra reel underneath the main grid that adds more chances on every spin. That extra reel is what makes the base game feel different from a plain 5x5.

Dig up four treasure chests full of diamonds to start the bonus, which uses key multipliers. Very high volatility, 5,000x max, and a 97.17% RTP – as good as anything BGaming makes. Free spins roughly once every 163 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.17% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
